                                SUBSTITUTE ORDINANCE


BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION I. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current DS-3 Downtown Service District symbols and
indications as shown on Map No. 2-G in the area bounded by:

       West Quincy Street; a line 402.96 feet east of and parallel to South Aberdeen Street; West
       Jackson Boulevard; and a line 195.95 feet east of and parallel to South Aberdeen Street

to those of a DR-5, Downtown Residential District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.
